basic_info.description: Lovely Noe Valley full floor condominium comprising 3-bed, 1 1/2 bath, 1-car garage parking located in an elegant Edwardian building. High ceilings, hardwood floors throughout and original details. Contemporary open concept kitchen that opens onto the exclusive deck. Shared garden and additional storage space in the garage. One block from Douglass Park and Philz Coffee. A+ location at the start of Noe Valley 24th Street shops, restaurants, amenities and transportation. HOA fees $225 monthly. Your Noe Valley life begins here!
